children.value: > Fact From Story: The Padres have reportedly sent Juan Soto to the Yankees in exchange for four pitchers and catcher Kyle Higashioka, according to the New York Post's Joel Sherman.

> > Fact From Story: Juan Soto immediately adds to a potent left-handed bat to a lineup sorely in need of some thump from the left side, and provides some much-needed support to 2022 AL MVP Aaron Judge.
> > > Fact From Story: The biggest star on the trade market has reportedly been traded.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Teams want to get the best players.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Teams want good players on their team.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Trading a player means that player will now play for a different team.
